title: Jubilant Algerian Pear Tagine
description: A cultured and crumbly Algerian dish featuring pears, made in a claypot and Whole30-friendly, this tagine is perfect for a special occasion. It is en-croute, energizing, and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel and core the pears, then slice them into wedges.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond flour, coconut oil, cinnamon, ginger, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced pears to the bowl and toss to coat with the dry mixture.
Transfer the pear mixture to a claypot and pour in the chicken broth and lemon juice.
Cover the claypot with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the pears are tender.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the tagine and serve hot.
